worlds.name: Echo Reef
worlds.description: Welcome to Echo Reef a calm‚ oceanlit hangout space filled with soft ambience‚ glowing coral‚ and gentle underwater soundscapes․ Whether youre here to chill with friends‚ explore the reef‚ or just escape the noise of the surface world‚ the deep is always ready to welcome you․ We also have the Twilight Zone a place of the horrors you see around From Angler Fish to a Goblin Shark explore and have fun We have our own Clicker Game （Yes FISH CLICKER） as well as a fish Scanner to explore with while the VIP users get a single NPC interaction

worlds.name: Ded Haven
worlds.description: Welcome to the Fiery world of Metal Music‚ explore the world and listen to heavy music without a care in the world‚ please don't throw things at the large beast it's not good for them nor attempt to jump into the lava （It's clearly not safe） World has simple games and features for you to mess around with and if lucky launch your friends in the sky if you can figure out the secret hidden in the world
